title: PAH-OMC-015 selects a separate counting-ensemble hypothesis and an early cutoff nondegeneracy gate
question: What bounded successor can supply the missing full-Q definition without repeating the unchanged-source absence audit or tuning an ensemble to the desired answer?
finding: The parent fixed-Q normalization and graded domain do not specify cross-Q probabilities. The operator requested a new goal. A separately labelled counting-reference ensemble on the existing graded union is selected for preregistered testing, with cutoff nondegeneracy of the four R-488 cylinders as its first necessary-condition gate. No mathematical test of this hypothesis has run.
decision_reason: An explicit additional model assumption and a discriminating necessary-condition test are more useful than repeated absence checks. This is auxiliary_support planning, not proof progress or closure of PAH-OMC-014.
boundary: One new ensemble hypothesis only; immutable functional, rates, carrier, projection and restricted parameter path. No active gate or claim tier change. The old app goal remains blocked because replacement was refused for an unfinished goal.
next_action: Hash-pin the goal and exact component multiplicities in a run manifest; then verify finite conditional recovery and stationarity and derive the fixed-n R-tail nondegeneracy bound before any volume-limit work.
method: Read the fixed-Q normalization, exact full-Q domain and restricted regulator path.
Compare unchanged-source lookup, arbitrary sector priors and a counting-reference extension at the definition level.
Separate a required nonzero limiting observable from finite positivity and from existence of a weak state limit.
Preserve the predecessor correction that exact projectivity is not necessary for weak convergence.
assumptions: The added full-domain counting reference is a new researcher hypothesis, not a consequence of the fixed-Q source or an empirically selected state.
missing_assumptions: Exact multiplicity/run manifest audit and finite ensemble admission.
Analytic cutoff nondegeneracy or a rigorous candidate-local failure bound and independent verification.
non_claims: No numerical or mathematical candidate result yet.
No full-regulator or weak-limit no-go follows from the planned restricted-path test.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity or TOE conclusion.
revisit_condition: One candidate and one necessary-condition checkpoint; revisit only on a changed source pin, definition, parameter path, target or genuinely new estimate. Do not add rescue weights automatically.
